increment: W1-P1.3 — Keyboard Navigation, Focus, and Accessibility Characterization
task: Task 4 — Keyboard and Accessibility Characterization Closure and Evidence Reconciliation
nature: Reconciliation and certification-readiness closure. No production source changed. No accepted behavioral test modified. Adds documentation (closure report + this file + ledger section) and refreshes integrity checksums.

lineage.focus: real-browser keyboard selection edge cases (23 tests)

openClose.keyboardOpen: ArrowDown/Up/Enter on closed (Space when enabled & non-searchable) open; emits open:{} then onOpen (KBD-001; T2-02)
openClose.initialActiveOnOpen: jsdom: no initial aria-activedescendant (empty selection); Chromium: first selectable option pre-activated across focus/keyboard-reopen/pointer paths (KBD-001; T2-02; T3-01; P1.3-D03)
openClose.escape: closes, close:{} (no public reason) (KBD-006; T2-03; P1.3-D01)
openClose.tab: closes; in Chromium focus advances to next tabbable (KBD-007; T2-03)

consolidatedContract.navigation: Arrow moves by one selectable step, skips disabled, clamps (no wrap); Home/End first/last; PageDown/PageUp +/-10; type-ahead on unmodified printable; Ctrl/Cmd+A only multi && !searchable (KBD-002..010; T2-02; T3-04)

range.shiftArrow: first Shift+ArrowDown from empty selects landing (anchor=landing); extends contiguous range; ascending registry order; plain Arrow does not change selection (T3-01)
range.shiftHomeEnd: endpoint-only selection, NOT contiguous extension (P1.3-D05; T3-02)
range.ctrlCmdShift: additive (preserves); plain Shift replaces prior selection (T3-03)
range.disabled: excluded from range fill by default; included when disabledOptionBehavior.selectable=true (T3-06)

payloads.ctrlCmdA: change-only (no select); values in registry order + matching indices; coverage boundary: values/indices/absence-of-select only, NOT exhaustive callback count (T3-04)
payloads.shiftRangeChronology: select(endpoint, selected=true, multi=true) -> change -> onChange -> onSelect; no open/close (T3-09)

focusAndAria.focusModel: DOM focus on host/combobox input; options not focus targets; active via aria-activedescendant (KBD-011; T2-04)
focusAndAria.ariaRelationships: aria-expanded reflects state; aria-activedescendant set on move/cleared on close; aria-controls -> listbox id (KBD-012; T2-05; T3-08)
focusAndAria.ariaBusy: listbox is the reflection target; genuinely busy => DOM aria-busy=true AND Chromium AX listbox busy=true; legacy host attr inert (ATTR-003; T2-09; P1.3-D02 resolved)
focusAndAria.selectedFirst: placement='selected-first' does not reorder DOM/navigation at tested configuration; bounded observation, not generalized (P1.3-D06; T3-05)

ariaBusy.jsdom: legacy host attr inert on listbox
ariaBusy.chromium: listbox reflects true + AX busy=true when genuinely busy

tabFocus.chromium: closes + advances focus to next tabbable

jsdomVsChromium.causeWithheld: P1.3-D03: browser observation preserved per open path; jsdom discrepancy NOT attributed to a single cause

P1.3-D01.title: public close detail {}; no reason (Escape/Tab indistinguishable)

P1.3-D02.title: aria-busy reflected on listbox (DOM + AX) when genuinely busy

P1.3-D03.title: open pre-activates first option in browser; jsdom differs

P1.3-D04.title: Tab closes but does not advance focus

P1.3-D05.title: Shift+Home/End selects only the boundary endpoint
P1.3-D05.status: Accepted observed, mode-specific; design intent open

P1.3-D06.title: selected-first does not reorder DOM/navigation (tested configuration)

limitationsPreserved.apg: Behaviors characterized as-is; deviations recorded, not normalized
